plan.notes: Official KVCC 2024-2025 Course Catalog (PDF), Nursing ADN Program, Associate in Science Degree, Total Credits 69. BIO213, ENG101, and MAT111 (marked *) are required within the curriculum and also part of the admission process; they are transcribed in the First Semester block as published. NUR126 LPN Transition to the ADN Role (1 cr) is required only of licensed practical nurses concurrent with NUR122 and is excluded from the standard 69-credit total (not transcribed as a credited course). PHI101 carries the catalog's (H) 'Suggested Elective' mark but is published in the Fourth Semester sequence and transcribed as listed.
